tablerow.td: Roll on the Near Death Table
Make a Mettle Check. Gain the Bloodied condition. Remove the remainder of the Stamina damage from the Health Pool. Remove further Stamina losses from Health, without reocurring Stamina Exhaustion.
If the roll is Damned then roll on the Insanity Table.
Out Of Luck Roll a d12 instead of a d20 when confirming their Critical Fails until Luck is next increased.
